# interfere_services (Data Source)

List up to 500 services in a workspace, ordered by namespace, name, and ID. Requires org:integration_settings:read. Use interfere_service to look up a specific service outside this list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "interfere_services" "workspace" {
  workspace_slug = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_slug` (String) Workspace URL slug, using lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

### Read-Only

- `services` (Attributes Set) The first 500 services in the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))

<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Unique service identifier.
- `name` (String) Telemetry service name.
- `namespace` (String) Telemetry service namespace, when supplied.
- `type` (String) Service type: unclassified, other, backend, or website.
